## Mode and median answer different questions {#l2-median-mode }

::: {.split }
::: {.column-block}

<h3>Mode</h3>

The value with the greatest frequency.

Read it from the tallest ordinary-frequency bar or the highest frequency-polygon point.

:::

::: {.column-block}

<h3>Median</h3>

The middle value in ordered data.

For an even total, average the values at positions $n/2$ and $n/2+1$.

:::
:::


::: {.takeaway}
Use cumulative counts to locate the middle positions.
:::

::: notes
A cumulative histogram has its tallest bar at the end; that does not identify the mode. If the graph uses equal-width classes, a modal class is the tallest ordinary-frequency bar. Median is an exact data calculation unless using grouped/interpolated estimates.
:::
